meta.name: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
meta.description:
After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10

videos.title: Spoiler: Gary Dies
videos.overview: After breaking a quantum-interference device, mild-mannered comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must save the universe from imminent destruction.

videos.title: Spoiler: Zack's in This One
videos.overview: Stuart, Bert, Denise, and Barry Kripke find themselves in an idyllic, peaceful Earth...that happens to be controlled by a repressive and vicious AI.

videos.title: Spoiler: Bert Is Magic
videos.overview: In a world where magic is real, Bert discovers a gift for sorcery, while Stuart enlists the help of one of this universe’s most powerful wizards.

videos.title: Spoiler: Stuart Makes a Wallet
videos.overview: Stuart questions what's real after landing in a mental hospital. Kripke finds himself with a new love interest.

videos.title: Spoiler: Bert Gets Married
videos.overview: The gang arrives in paradise, where everyone lives in harmony with nature and each other. Bert finds true love and the machine is broken.

videos.title: Spoiler: Corn Is Delicious
videos.overview: As Bert and Kripke team up, Stuart and Denise take a big step forward in a universe that looks and feels normal...with one major difference.

videos.title: Spoiler: Dexys Midnight Runners Get a Royalty Payment
videos.overview: While attempting to steal a new piece of technology from Caltech, Stuart, Denise, Bert, and Kripke run into some very familiar visitors.

videos.title: Spoiler: We're as Confused as You Are
videos.overview: After being thrust into a world that is perpetually at war, Stuart must complete his mission before he and the rest of the gang can flee to safety.

videos.title: Spoiler: We Couldn't Get Green Lantern
videos.overview: After finding themselves trapped in a comic book, Stuart, Denise, Bert, and Kripke must enlist the help of a superhero – and avoid a supervillain!

videos.title: Spoiler: Filmed Before a Live Studio Audience
videos.overview: The gang suddenly finds themselves back in the comic book store – but where is that laughter coming from?

meta.slogan: Every universe needs a hero. We got Stuart.
